does: Gives Cursor the same parts, with hub's hooks, the start text and copies of the agents.

children.does: Writes hub's plugin folder to ~/.cursor/plugins/local/hub. Its hooks call this copy of hub.
Gives Cursor the start text at the start of each chat.
Writes a copy of each agent that runs to ~/.cursor/agents, with Cursor's model name.
Cursor's name for each model, as model=name pairs. The effort goes after the name in brackets.
Cursor has no output styles, so the parts of hub's style that run go first in Cursor's start text.
Shows the tuner's line as the first line of the next chat in Cursor.
